# Catalog reference

Every method of the catalog resources and every object they return. Types link to their section; objects used by several areas are in [shared objects](shared.md).

## Structure

The objects each method returns, and the objects inside them. An object is expanded the first time it appears.

- `catalog()`: [`Catalog`](#catalog)
  - `products()`: `list<`[`Product`](#product)`>`
    - `name()`: [`LocalizedText`](#localizedtext)
    - `description()`: [`LocalizedText`](#localizedtext)
    - `docsUrl()`: `?`[`LocalizedText`](#localizedtext)
  - `sources()`: `list<`[`Source`](#source)`>`
  - `packs()`: `list<`[`Pack`](#pack)`>`
  - `freeTier()`: `?`[`FreeTier`](#freetier)
    - `conditions()`: `?`[`LocalizedText`](#localizedtext)
  - `limits()`: `?`[`Limits`](#limits)
  - `limitsByPlan()`: `array<string, `[`PlanLimits`](#planlimits)`|null>`
